title: Program Terms, Section 6 — Cancelling a Tailwise Plus Tier
content:
**6.1 Who cancels.** Only the customer can cancel a paid tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**.

**6.2 Refund window.** The fee of the current term is refunded only if the cancellation is requested no later than the tier's full-refund days after that fee was charged. The window is counted in calendar days from the date of the fee charge entry of the current term on the rewards history, that date being day 0; a request on the last day is in time.

**6.3 In-window cancellation.** An in-window cancellation ends the paid tier the same day, refunds that fee to the original payment and moves the membership to the free tier earned by spend. Perk credit already used in the term is deducted from the refund.

**6.4 Outside the window.** The cancellation takes effect at the tier's effective point — the end of the billing month for Tailwise Plus Monthly, the end of the term for the annual tiers. Auto-renewal is switched off, paid benefits continue until then, and nothing is refunded unless the tier provides a prorated refund after the window.

**6.5 Withdrawal.** A pending cancellation may be withdrawn by the customer until it takes effect.

**6.6 Trials.** Cancelling a trial before the trial end date ends the paid tier at once with no fee.

### Refund window — boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Current term's fee charged (day 0) | Last day in time (day 30) | Cancellation on the last day | Cancellation the day after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 January | 4 February | refund of that fee | no refund; effective at the end of the term |
| 1 June | 1 July | refund of that fee | no refund; effective at the end of the term |


### Refund with perk credit used (hypothetical)
A Tailwise Plus Premier Annual fee of $119.00 was charged and $25.00 of perk credit has been used in the term. An in-window cancellation refunds $94.00 to the original payment — $119.00 less the $25.00 used — and the paid tier ends that day.

### Outside the window (hypothetical)
A Tailwise Plus Monthly member cancels mid-month: auto-renewal is switched off, the paid benefits run to the end of the billing month, and no part of the fee comes back.
